tips.en: I'd like to exchange some money.

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.en: Next, please. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: I'd like to exchange some money into US dollars.

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.en: Sure. How much would you like to change?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Two hundred dollars, please. What's the rate today?
turns.ko: 이백 달러로 주세요. 오늘 환율이 어떤가요?

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.en: It's one thousand three hundred fifty won to the dollar.

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.en: No extra fees. May I see your passport?
turns.ko: 추가 수수료는 없습니다. 여권 보여 주시겠어요?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Here you are. Could I have some small bills, too?
turns.ko: 여기 있습니다. 작은 지폐도 좀 주시겠어요?

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.en: Sure. Please count it. Here's your receipt.
turns.ko: 네. 잘 세어 보세요. 영수증 드립니다.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Thank you. Have a good day.
